runtime.reloadRepair: The disposable launcher omitted .gitignore, allowing Tailwind to watch D1/registry runtime files and trigger repeated Vite full reloads. Preserving ignore rules and adding snapshot-only exclusions fixed the cause. Independent observation changed from 8 full reloads in 30 seconds to zero; the actual scanner found zero runtime files.

Read-only launcher inspection found cancellation absent during source setup; lifecycle-wide cancellation now covers setup and command gaps, with a dedicated test.
Review found untracked files could enter the preview. The launcher now copies only Git-tracked, explicitly allowed source/asset paths, tested with a temporary Git repository.
